conceptDescriptions:
Concept: HasId
Description: Records that expose a stable order identifier.
Fields:
- id: string(nonEmpty)

Concept: OrderShape
Description: The raw backend order payload shape.
Fields:
- id: string(nonEmpty)
- customerId: string(nonEmpty)
- status: "new" | "paid" | "fulfilled" | "cancelled"
- totalCents: number(int)
- currency: "USD"
- items: number(int, >=1)

Concept: PricedOrder
Description: Order records ready for pricing, validation, and export work.
Composed from:
- HasId
- OrderShape
Fields:
- id: string(nonEmpty)
- customerId: string(nonEmpty)
- status: "new" | "paid" | "fulfilled" | "cancelled"
- totalCents: number(int)
- currency: "USD"
- items: number(int, >=1)
templateDescriptions:
Template: summarizeOrder
Description: Summarize an order before export-side enrichment.
Requires:
  Concept: PricedOrder
  Description: Order records ready for pricing, validation, and export work.
  Composed from:
  - HasId
  - OrderShape
  Fields:
  - id: string(nonEmpty)
  - customerId: string(nonEmpty)
  - status: "new" | "paid" | "fulfilled" | "cancelled"
  - totalCents: number(int)
  - currency: "USD"
  - items: number(int, >=1)
